bandwidth_sweep.empirical_check: report perturbation spectral centroid and Laplacian-band energy fractions

claim_guard.mechanism_language: frequency-selective temporal aggregation behavior and graph-Fourier diagnostics

controlled_drift_sweep.physical_reality_note: not a replacement for the separately completed raw V/I physical-unit drift benchmark
controlled_drift_sweep.sign: stable-hash sign per cell x feature x perturbation seed
controlled_drift_sweep.trajectory: linear causal ramp from zero at first observation to signed terminal shift at final observation

descriptive_outputs: actual path-Laplacian eigenvalue summaries by cell length
clean residual graph-Fourier band-energy fractions by model

feature_space.purpose: controlled mechanism experiment; not physical sensor realism

graph_operator.boundary_rule: first valid observation uses self only
graph_operator.depth_sweep_role: analytic aggregation-operator response only; not separately trained depth models
graph_operator.model_operator: causal parameter-free mean aggregation over {self, previous valid observation}

laplacian_graph_fourier.graph: undirected path graph P_n for each cell trajectory
laplacian_graph_fourier.input_spectral_quantity: energy of clean standardized feature trajectories projected onto the path-Laplacian basis
laplacian_graph_fourier.reason_for_separate_definition: the deployed causal operator is directed and non-symmetric; an orthonormal graph-Fourier basis is therefore defined on the corresponding undirected chronological path graph
laplacian_graph_fourier.residual_spectral_quantity: energy of per-cycle prediction residual trajectories projected onto the same cell-specific basis

primary_frequency_inference.multiple_testing: Holm across four domains separately for RMSE and four domains separately for MAE
primary_frequency_inference.summary: trapezoidal AUC of relative degradation over the frozen omega/pi frequency grid, normalized by frequency-range width

prohibited_during_protocol_freeze: change grid after seeing spectral outcomes
use future observations in model input
call the causal model a spectral GCN
scientific_role: Mechanistic temporal-frequency robustness analysis; not a claim that the causal GCN is a spectral GCN.

sinusoidal_frequency_sweep.clean_reference: same frozen run with zero perturbation
sinusoidal_frequency_sweep.per_cell_feature_waveform: cos(omega*t+phase), scaled to exact requested RMS when numerically well-defined
sinusoidal_frequency_sweep.phase: deterministic stable-hash phase per cell x feature x perturbation seed
